items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: Yes, I do. Did you ever play with him? No, I never did. But I remember Jelly real well.

ctx.x: Do you remember Jelly Roll Morton?

Yes, I do. Did you ever play with him? No, I never did. But I remember Jelly real well. I mean, more in New York than here. Mm-hmm. Because I was, I, I was in New York from, from, uh, 28 to 31. And that was just about the, the latter part of Jelly Roll Morton. Who'd you play with when, when you were there in those years? I was Joe. I worked with Jack Trettis. And I worked with a band, uh, in the Pennsylvania Hotel. Glenn Miller, we didn't have any brass. It was a, it was a takeoff on, on Rudy's valet. But we had,…
